author: Killian_Thvn
name: Pomodoro Focus Timer
description: Boost your productivity with a simple, elegant Pomodoro timer right in your browser. This extension helps you manage your time using the Pomodoro technique — 25 minutes of focused work followed by a 5-minute break. Customize session lengths, get desktop notifications, and stay in the zone with minimal distractions. Perfect for students, developers, writers, and anyone who wants to work smarter
